figurative_meaning_bn: কড়া জান; যে সহজে মরে না এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Tough life; someone who does not die easily
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুড়ো লোকটার কই মাছের প্রাণ, এত অসুখে মরেও মরছে না।
এই গাছের কই মাছের প্রাণ, ঝড়-জল সব সহ্য করে বেঁচে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The old man has the life of a koi fish; he won't die even with so much illness.
This tree has the life of a koi fish, surviving storms and floods.
history: The idiom draws from the resilience of the koi fish (Climbing perch), a common freshwater fish in Bengal known for its ability to survive in low-oxygen waters and even on land for short periods.
note: Koi fish symbolizes endurance in Bengali folklore.
